Douglas County News — Openings & Closings | DougCo Social DougCo Social

New openings, closings, development, and community updates from Castle Rock, Parker, Highlands Ranch, Lone Tree, Castle Pines, and across Douglas County — first-person coverage you won't find anywhere else.
Egg Harbor Cafe Is Coming to Belleview Station in Denver

The family-owned breakfast brand that opened in Highlands Ranch this spring is expanding — a second Colorado location is coming to Belleview Station in southeast Denver, looking like a September opening.

Douglas County approved $7.5 million toward a 75,000-square-foot Gold Crown youth field house in Castle Rock's Dawson Trails — six basketball courts, a dozen volleyball courts, and an early-2028 opening.

105 West Brewing's all-inclusive Castle Rock Beer Fest Under the Stars returns Saturday, Sept 12, 2026, 4–9pm at the Philip S. Miller Park Amphitheater — 25+ Colorado breweries, 7+ food trucks, unlimited tastings, and live music. It sells out; no door sales.

The 24th Annual Taste of Douglas County returns Thursday, Aug 20, 2026, 5–8pm — an indoor, air-conditioned evening of food samples from dozens of area restaurants, drinks, and live entertainment at the Douglas County Events Center in Castle Rock. $10 in advance, $20 at the door.
GQue BBQ Coming to Parker — Taking Over the Former Freddy's Space

GQue BBQ, Colorado's championship-BBQ chain, is coming to Parker's Crown Point Center at 18424 Cottonwood Dr — the former Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers space. A Town of Parker permit describes the remodel. No opening date yet.
Shake Shack Opening in Parker August 12 — In the Former Wendy's Spot
Shake Shack is opening its first Parker location at 9185 Crown Crest Blvd on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 — in the space that formerly housed a Wendy's. Here's what we know.

A 31-acre, $400 million mixed-use district is under construction on Castle Rock's west side — a sports center, a hotel, six restaurants, and hundreds of homes, from the same developer behind Riverwalk downtown.

Signage for the former Wild Goose Saloon space at 11160 S Pikes Peak Dr in Parker now reads JP Cocina & Cantina, a Mexican cantina — a shift from the JP's Sports Bar name announced earlier in 2026. Ownership, menu and opening date are not yet confirmed.

Salady — billed as South Korea's largest salad franchise, with 300-plus stores — is coming to Parker at 9700 S Parker Rd, in the Parker Gateway Marketplace next to Einstein Bros Bagels, as the Korean chain expands across the U.S. The exterior sign is up, and staff on site say the store is targeting an August 2026 opening.

A new permanent sculpture called Big Drive — a bull, cow, and calf standing about 11 feet tall and 20 feet wide — is being installed at Castle Rock's Rock Park Open Space, where the Town's Western Heritage Cattle Drive begins each summer. Here's the story, the artists behind it, and the July 22 dedication.
Lost Canyon Ranch Open Space: I Hiked Every Open Trail. Here's the Guide.

Castle Rock's Lost Canyon Ranch Open Space opened July 13, 2026. I hiked all 10 miles over two days. Here is every open trail with real distance, elevation and shade, both trailheads, what is still closed, and what to know before you go. No dogs.
Pick N Tap: Indoor Pickleball, Golf, and a Restaurant Are Coming to Parker
The Town of Parker has approved Pick N Tap, a 19,960-square-foot restaurant with indoor pickleball courts and golf simulators at 11735 Disha Drive. Construction is expected to start soon.

The Southern fast-casual chain Chicken Salad Chick is finally underway in Castle Rock's Meadows neighborhood, near the movie theater and across from the hospitals. Dirt is moving on a location with a patio and drive-thru; an opening date hasn't been announced yet.

After 23 years in Castle Rock, world-championship magicians Carol Massie and Joe Givan have reopened as the Magic Manor — an intimate 90-seat magic theatre and event venue inside a historic 1908 Victorian property in Sedalia, the former Gabriel's Italian Restaurant.
24 Hour Fitness South Parker Closed for Renovation — Reopens July 11

The South Parker Super-Sport club at 11445 Twenty Mile Rd is temporarily closed for a targeted renovation and set to reopen July 11, 2026 — the same renovation 24 Hour Fitness just completed at its Castle Rock club. Expect the basketball court swapped out for an expanded free-weight area and turf zone, plus new equipment.
Black Rock Coffee Bar Now Open at Parker Road & Stroh Road
Black Rock Coffee Bar is now open at 6940 Stroh Rd (Parker Road & Stroh Road), opening Tuesday, June 30, 2026 — its third Parker location and 19th in Colorado, with a week of grand-opening specials.
Inside Emagine Parker: Opening Date, Photos & Prices

We toured Emagine Parker — Colorado's first Emagine theater, inside the former AMC Twenty Mile 10 — the night before it opened. Here's what it's actually like inside, with photos: 10 auditoriums, two EMX large-format screens, heated recliners, cuddle chairs, ticket prices, a full Colorado bar, and Little Dot Pizza.
The Groove Café Now Open at Lyric at RidgeGate in Lone Tree

The Groove — the new neighborhood hub at the Lyric at RidgeGate community in Lone Tree — is now open at 10930 Lyric Street, with a café serving coffee, breakfast, lunch, and dinner alongside a restaurant, welcome center, fitness area, and pool.

Denver-based Cerebral Brewing is opening its fourth taproom at 20117 East Mainstreet in downtown Parker. A 4,200-square-foot space inside the East Main development, with a roughly 2,000-square-foot patio, opens summer 2027.
Peaky Peak Coffee & Charcuterie — Lone Tree Concept Expanding to Denver and Parker

Peaky Peak Coffee & Charcuterie — Quy and Tracy Nguyen's Vietnamese-coffee-meets-charcuterie concept in Lone Tree — is expanding, with a second location in Denver's Golden Triangle and a third now confirmed for Parker's Mainstreet.
24 Hour Fitness Castle Rock Reopens After Renovation — May 27 Soft Opening

The Castle Rock Super-Sport club at 5745 New Abbey Ln reopens Wednesday, May 27 after a targeted renovation: 50 pieces of new equipment, an expanded Zone, new flooring and paint, and the new Reformer24 private Pilates studio. Here are the soft-opening details, presale pricing, and what's already in the club.
Champagne Velvet Proper Kitchen & Bar Castle Rock — What We Tried, Menu, and What to Know

Champagne Velvet Proper Kitchen & Bar opened Sunday, May 17, 2026 at 2355 Mercantile St in Castle Rock — the rebrand of the former I.C. Brewhouse, named for Upland Brewing's 1902 'Million Dollar Flavor' pilsner. We went for lunch on opening day. Here's what we tried, the full menu, and what to know before you go.
Hideaway Bar & Grill in Castle Rock Hit by Two Fires in Two Days — How to Help the Staff
Starbird Chicken's Castle Rock location opens Monday, April 27, 5–9pm at the Promenade. Soft opening notes, menu highlights, hours, and patio details.
Lone Tree is building High Note Regional Park in the Lyric neighborhood. Phase 1 includes playgrounds, a dog park, sports fields, and a beer garden. Opening 2027.

Lazy Dog Restaurant & Bar is coming to Castle Rock Promenade. The HR location's success is the bet.

The California chain that runs the Highlands Ranch lodge-themed dog patio is building a Castle Rock location at 5949 Alpine Vista Circle in the Promenade development. Opening date not yet confirmed for 2026. The Castle Rock Promenade restaurant cluster keeps growing.

Pam Briere's Italian concept opened January 7, 2025. Hand-pulled pasta, wood-fired pizza, a short-rib ravioli that locals have started ordering by name. Sixteen months in, Ovest Via has graduated from "new restaurant" to "the answer when somebody asks where to eat in Parker."
Starbird Chicken opens at the Castle Rock Promenade. The Mexican-restaurant block just got a chicken concept three doors down.

The premium fast-casual chicken chain opened its second Colorado location at 6360 Promenade Parkway on Monday, April 27. It sits in the same block as Savina's Mexican Kitchen and Los Dos Potrillos Castle Rock, and signals what this stretch of Promenade is becoming: a five-storefront restaurant cluster on the south side of town.
